narrative.overview:
The platform site is Swiss type shot with the shutter open: periwinkle light, one coral creature, and the real product, moved by the scroll. It now speaks in two registers that share one palette and one creature.

The **studio register** carries the homepage (`/platform`) and Signals (`/platform/signals`). Both are getlayers templates re-purposed for Anarix: the homepage is "AI Studio" (a gradient hero card that tilts and collapses into a 3D ring of the five products over a giant marquee, Aan's white diamond opening into a black world with a particle sphere and the manifesto, pinned horizontal product panels, and fragments drifting past a card that opens into the close), and Signals is "Relay" (black, a halo of light fibres behind everything, dark glass cards, mono labels). Headlines here are Inter 500, larger in size than in weight; light comes from deep-blue-to-periwinkle gradients with a coral glow, from the three.js particle sphere, and from the Signals halo. The homepage is a mix of every product (Signals, Profitability, Rules, MCP, Ask Aan), never a page about Aan alone.

The **screen register** carries the other product pages (Profitability, Rules, MCP with its pinned McpGap scene, and Aan). It is the Phase 8 system: one idea per `Screen`, Inter 800 headlines on a 12-column grid, long-exposure light trails converging on what matters, real product UI on `ProductFrame` cards that turn toward the cursor, and one travelling, limbless Aan.

In both registers the proof is the product: every visual that is not light or Aan is real Anarix UI, and every number in it is labelled as sample data. Aan, the coral diamond from the Ask Aan island, is flat and matte everywhere except one place, the homepage close, where `GlossyAan` renders it as the site's single glossy three.js object. Rejected and gone: soft clay (`ClayBlock`, the clay mascot shading, the clay CTA), the City Nocturne line-art scenes and the soft isometric "circuit" drawings. None of them return.
keyCharacteristics: Two registers on one palette: studio (Inter 500, gradient cards, black worlds, pinned GSAP scenes) on the homepage and Signals; screen (Inter 800, `Screen`, `ProductFrame`, `LightTrails`, travelling Aan) on the other product pages.
Only periwinkle (230) and coral (355) carry hue; studio surfaces blend from one to the other.
Real product UI everywhere, always labelled "Sample data" or "Illustrative".
Lenis smooth scroll under GSAP ScrollTrigger timelines that are pinned and scrubbed; transforms and opacity only while scrolling.
Aan is flat and limbless; the one glossy Aan stands in the homepage close.
IBM Plex Mono for indexes, clocks, figures and honest labels; Fraunces for written moments and for the single italic word in a Signals headline.

rules.name: The No Green Rule
rules.body: Positive is periwinkle, negative is coral, in every card, chart, halo and theme. No hue between roughly 60 and 180 enters the site.

rules.name: The Two Hues Rule
rules.body: Only periwinkle (230) and coral (355) carry hue. A studio surface may blend from one to the other, and the blend's middle stops are the violets between them (`#c993d6`, `#6a5fe0`); a violet never appears on its own as a flat fill, a text colour or a UI state.

rules.name: The Coral Is Aan's Rule
rules.body: Coral is Aan, something going wrong, or the warm glow at the foot of a studio gradient. It is never a button fill, a heading, a link or a UI state of success.

rules.name: The One Risk Trail Rule
rules.body: A set of light trails is all periwinkle, except that a screen about a risk may run exactly one trail coral (`risk` index on `LightTrails`), and only while that risk is live.

rules.name: The Scope Rule
rules.body: In the screen register, colours come from the `.nocturne` roles (`--sky`, `--ink`, `--ink-2`, `--accent`, `--accent-solid`, `--risk`, `--risk-ink`, `--rule`, `--card`, `--card-line`, `--bubble-*`) and theme is the whole page at a different hour. The studio register is the exception and stays fixed in both themes: the homepage is a white stage with black worlds, Signals is black. Studio cards re-set the product UI roles locally so the same components render on them.

rules.name: The Weight Per Register Rule
rules.body: Screen-register headlines are Inter 800 between -0.04em and -0.055em, line-height under 1, fluid by both width and height (`min(vw, svh)`). Studio-register headlines are Inter 500 between -0.04em and -0.045em, line-height 1 to 1.08. Never mix the two weights in one section.

rules.name: The Grey Prose, Ink Phrase Rule
rules.body: Prose is the quieter ink; only the phrases that carry the argument switch to full ink at 500. In studio headlines the same move runs the other way: the second line drops to white at 55–60%. Emphasis is contrast, not colour or size.

rules.name: The Written Word Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for writing that reads as written by someone (the morning brief, Aan's letter) and, in Signals only, for one italic word per headline. It never sets a whole headline, a figure or UI.

rules.name: The Mono Counts Rule
rules.body: Plex Mono sets numbers that count, time or order something, and the sample-data notes. Every figure that changes uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The One Viewport Rule
rules.body: Above 620px of height, a `fit="screen"` section and every pinned studio scene is exactly one viewport; cut copy or hide optional detail instead. QA is `scripts/qa/screens.mjs` at 1280x720, 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080 and 390x844 with `fit-check.js`: a `Screen` is checked at its top, a `StoryScroll` at the middle of each chapter, and a GSAP-pinned `[data-pin]` scene at its start and at 36%, 68% and 98% through its pin-spacer. Flowing Relay sections on Signals are not screens and are not held to one viewport.

rules.name: The Pinned Scene Rule
rules.body: A long story is a pinned, scrubbed scene, and its number is set by the page's register: the homepage is three pinned scenes back to back, Signals has one, a screen-register page has at most one (`StoryScroll` or a GSAP pin, such as MCP's `McpGap`).

rules.name: The Ruled, Not Boxed Rule
rules.body: In the screen register, group with space first and a 1px Rule hairline second (`.c-points`, proof figures, the permission ladder). Only product UI, studio cards, the film and video frames are boxed, and nothing is a card inside a card except product UI inside a studio card or panel, which is the template's own device.

rules.name: The Light Is The Depth Rule
rules.body: Lift comes from light (trails, pools, floor glows, the cursor spotlight, the particle sphere, the halo, radial glows) and from real perspective, never from a hover lift or a hard offset shadow. Every surface is matte. The one glossy object on the site is `GlossyAan` in the homepage close (a clearcoated coral `MeshPhysicalMaterial` lit by a studio environment), standing where AI Studio has its chrome star; nothing else gets a sheen or a glossy gradient.

rules.name: The No Clay Rule
rules.body: Soft clay is retired. Aan, the primary CTA and every block are flat: no lit top edges, core shadows, contact shadows or pressed-in labels.

rules.name: The Smooth Scroll Rule
rules.body: Nothing re-renders React per scroll frame: scroll scenes write transforms and opacity through GSAP, the halo sets shader uniforms, and layout is measured on ScrollTrigger refresh only (`invalidateOnRefresh`, function-based values, the halo's `measure` on `refresh`). WebGL draws only while it can be seen (the sphere is switched by its ScrollTrigger, Glossy Aan by an IntersectionObserver, the halo stops when the tab is hidden). Reduced motion shows each scene's end state and leaves Lenis off.

rules.name: The Transform And Opacity Rule
rules.body: Animate transform and opacity. The exceptions the build carries are the blur-rise reveals, the trails' stroke draw, colour and glow transitions on hover and state, Aan's cube and bar morphs, and the Intro's hero frame collapsing onto its centre card by `clip-path`; add no more.

rules.name: The Depth Drift Rule
rules.body: Parallax exists only inside pinned studio scenes, as depth: each gallery panel's UI drifts 14% against its frame, and the Finale's fragments travel at speeds set by their depth. The screen register has none.

dos: **Do** keep periwinkle and coral as the only hues; let studio gradients blend between them and nowhere else.

**Do** take every screen-register colour from the `.nocturne` roles so night and day both work, and keep the studio register's fixed grounds (white stage and black worlds on the homepage, black on Signals).

**Do** set screen-register headlines in Inter 800 (`.t-h2`, the name sizes) and studio headlines in Inter 500, and keep Fraunces for the morning brief, Aan's letter and one italic word per Signals headline.
**Do** show real product UI with an honest label ("Sample data", "Sample rule", "Sample conversation", "Sample message", "Illustrative"), in a `ProductFrame` or on a studio card or panel.
**Do** give the homepage every product (Signals, Profitability, Rules, MCP, Ask Aan), never a page about Aan alone.
**Do** keep proof figures to $1.2B GMV, 500+ brands and 12.8% TACoS.
**Do** name marketplaces and apps (Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, Slack, Claude) as text.

**Do** build scroll scenes as pinned, scrubbed GSAP timelines over Lenis, moving transforms and opacity, measuring on refresh only, and mark them `data-pin` so `fit-check.js` checks them through the pin.
**Do** pause WebGL when it cannot be seen and load three.js only when the component mounts.
**Do** design the reduced-motion state on purpose: each scene's end state shown in flow, nothing travelling, no Lenis.
**Do** keep the nav, the Ask Aan island and the footer at parity with www.anarix.ai.
donts: **Don't** use green, teal or any hue outside periwinkle (230) and coral (355), or a flat violet fill on its own.
**Don't** use coral for buttons, headings, links or success states.
**Don't** give Aan arms, legs, hands or a face beyond its two eyes, or restyle it outside the island's `AanMascot`, the ring card's white diamond and `GlossyAan`.
**Don't** bring back soft clay, City Nocturne line-art scenes or the soft isometric drawings.
**Don't** add a second glossy object; `GlossyAan` in the homepage close is the only one.
**Don't** set React state from scroll, animate layout properties while scrolling, or measure the DOM on a scroll frame.
**Don't** show an unlabelled number in product UI, or invent customers, testimonials, logos or prices.
**Don't** let a `fit="screen"` section or a pinned scene grow past one viewport above 620px of height.
**Don't** add hover lifts, hard offset shadows or gradient text.
**Don't** add parallax outside a pinned studio scene, or a second pinned story to a screen-register page.
**Don't** bring the film's stamp red, Bodoni or grain onto site pages.
